input.behavior_to_protect: After merging, both the Connection header itself and any header it names must be absent from the result.

description: Write one regression scenario where the Connection header names a custom hop-by-hop field; after merging, both the Connection header itself and the named field must be absent from the result. The scenario must fail a mutant that only strips the standard hop-by-hop set.
requirements: Return one JSON test scenario using only the supplied values. It must make the correct behavior pass and the named mutant fail.
